Game Overview

In Hungry Birds, the core idea is straightforward: soar and snack in Hungry Birds. Tap to propel your bird skyward, devouring delicious fruits along the way. With endless, increasingly challenging levels, stunning graphics, and fluid gameplay, see how high you can score while adapting to any device. Can you become the top bird?
